detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic realistic 3D style with warm golden-hour sunset lighting and soft natural detail.
[Shot 1] A close-up opens low on the black boots of <Subject 1>, toes angled toward the camera, the boot leather and the hem of his blue-green robe flecked with fresh brown mud. The camera tilts up steadily along his seated legs and torso, revealing his right hand resting on the edge of the minivan's rear door and his left hand loosely holding a lit cigarette between two fingers, a thin wisp of smoke curling upward. The tilt settles on his face: sharp cold brows, calm narrowed eyes, a faint mud smudge near his jaw, his expression detached, cool, and quietly imposing as he gazes past the camera. Warm sunset light rims his profile while wind rustles faintly.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2> sitting on the same rear door. She is petite, and her silver-booted feet dangle above the ground with her ankles crossed, the crossed feet kicking back and forth slowly in a cheerful, relaxed rhythm, her white fox ears twitching lightly. She holds a peeled section of sugarcane in both hands, bites off a piece, and chews with slow, contented movements, her cheeks puffing slightly and her blue eyes narrowing in enjoyment. She then turns her head to the side and spits the dry chewed pulp down onto the dirt, adding to the scattered pale fibers on the ground. The crisp bite, wet chewing, and a single soft spitting sound are clearly audible over the wind.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a frontal medium shot of the full scene in <Subject 3> and holds for the remaining seven seconds: the white minivan parked on the muddy dirt road beside tall sugarcane rows, its rear hatch raised open. <Subject 1> sits on the left side of the open trunk sill, leaning back against the door frame without moving, his left hand holding the cigarette with smoke drifting slowly sideways in the breeze, his right hand resting on the door edge, mud stains visible on his robe and boots. <Subject 2> sits on the right, her short legs dangling with her crossed boots never touching the ground, the crossed feet kicking back and forth slowly in a happy, relaxed rhythm. She takes another small bite of sugarcane and keeps chewing contentedly without spitting, her fox ears flicking once, the earlier spat-out pulp scattered on the ground below. <Subject 4>, the jade-green flying sword with segmented bamboo-like ridges and a gold-trimmed wrapped hilt, stands stuck upright in the ground at <Subject 1>'s right side, its blade catching the golden light. The camera pushes in very slowly throughout the shot as the sunset glow deepens and sugarcane leaves sway at the frame edges.

Continuous rural evening ambience: wind rustling through tall sugarcane leaves, distant birds and insects, and a faint open-field room tone; a soft cigarette crackle near Han Li and crisp sugarcane biting and chewing sounds near Silver Moon, with one soft spitting sound early on.
